lesson: Both shorts failed by attempting to front-run bearish momentum into oversold RSI levels, ignoring that DOGE often ignores mean reversion during extreme fear. The system is incorrectly prioritizing bearish structure over localized bullish divergences, leading to entries that lack sufficient confirmation of trend exhaustion.
adjustment: Require a confirmed Market Structure Shift (MSS) on the 1h timeframe before entering any short position, rather than relying on high-timeframe bearish bias alone.
methodology_flag: Trust RSI-based oversold signals less on DOGEUSDT during high-volatility markdown phases.
